evidence.C1: Coherent warm cream/green palette and the tank is the hero, but fishing, garden, and focus screens feel more functional than distinctive.
evidence.C2: Main actions are labelled and findable, e.g. 'Feed, Care, Scape, Residents, Shop, Photo, Watch, Share' and 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast'.
evidence.C3: Feature summary lists interlocking loops: care, fishing, breeding, scaping, greenhouse, reef genetics, orders, journal, and focus.
evidence.C4: Consistent cards, pills, and nav, but some rough edges remain, e.g. bait list appears cut off and the breathing circle is clipped.

fixes: Raise the visual craft of non-tank screens so fishing, garden, and focus match the tank's field-guide quality.
Fix phone clipping and cramped areas, especially fishing bait lists, focus breathing, and toast placement.
Make interlocking loops more visible in the UI, such as care cuttings feeding greenhouse, fishing catches feeding journal/tank, and orders linking back to care.

evidence.C1: Coherent warm cream palette with green accents, tank drawn as glass box with perspective side panes and depth haze, distinctive fishing scenery (lily pads, mountains), but fish in tank look small and similar; journal silhouettes are a nice touch but limited variety visible.
evidence.C2: Clear onboarding text 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', tools row clearly labeled (Feed/Care/Scape/Residents/Shop/Photo/Watch/Share), greenhouse has numbered 1-4 steps, fishing shows 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', focus has clear time presets; phone layout stacks cleanly without cramping.
evidence.C3: Multiple interlocking loops: nitrogen cycle care, 9-spot fishing minigame with reel/tension, breeding with inherited colours, aquascaping (16 plants/8 hardscape/3 substrates), greenhouse with variegated sports, reef lab with named strains, journal dex with 47 species and 18 milestones, focus timer with box breathing, offline catch-up. Clearly exceeds typical cozy aquarium.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating nav, card shadows across all screens; unobtrusive toast 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more'; water test tiles uniform; minor rough edge: desktop tank view leaves large empty area in side column below 'Today's care'.

fixes: Increase visual variety and detail of fish in the tank — current fish look small and similar, undermining the 'tank art is the hero' goal despite the 47 species claim.
Better balance the desktop tank layout — the right side column has noticeable empty space below the care checklist; either expand content or widen the tank.

Add more distinctive scenery detail to fishing spots beyond lily pond — the other 8 spots (rice terraces, mangrove roots, glacier floes, harbour pilings) need equal visual treatment to match the field-guide aesthetic.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette, serif headings, 'glass box (perspective side panes, receding gravel floor, depth haze)' tank, field-guide touches like 'Poecilia reticulata' dex cards; but tank fish read as tiny slivers against large plant masses and side-column cards are fairly generic white cards, so not yet 'every screen feels designed'.
evidence.C2: Next-step hints everywhere: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', 'Line is slack. Reel', garden's 4-step 'How the greenhouse works'; phone tools are a labelled 2x4 grid, nothing cramped. Only nit: opaque stats like 'Stocking 0.5 of 2.2 capacity' lack an inline gloss.
evidence.C3: All anchor loops present and interlocking: nitrogen-cycle care, flick/reel/drag fishing with tournaments, breeding with 'inherited colours', scaping, greenhouse ('trimming gives cuttings'), reef strain crossing, orders ('deliver them for orders'), 47-species journal, focus timer earning shells.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards and dark hint pills across screens; unobtrusive top toasts ('My first tank is ready', 'Unlocked: Mountain stream...'); tidy empty states ('No cuttings yet', 'Not found yet') and progress states ('60% grown, about 29 min left'). No visible misalignment, but not verified as pixel-tidy everywhere.

fixes: Make the tank's fish the hero at default zoom: fish are currently tiny slivers against big plant masses - increase fish size/presence or add a focal fish so the hero art reads instantly.

Extend the field-guide identity beyond the journal: give the side-column cards, care tiles and fishing panels specimen-plate detailing (rule lines, numbering, serif labels) so every screen feels designed rather than generic-card.
Add plain-language glosses for opaque numbers ('Stocking 0.5 of 2.2 capacity', raw ppm tiles) inline or on first tap, so first-time players are never left guessing.
